subtitle: Lesson 6 · Two Tasks, one Stream, two different jobs

code:
CREATE TASK ticket_facts_sync_task
  WAREHOUSE = DRIFTWOOD_WH
  SCHEDULE = '5 MINUTE'
  WHEN SYSTEM$STREAM_HAS_DATA('raw.tickets_stream')
AS
  MERGE INTO marts.ticket_facts ...
  WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET ...
  WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ...
caption: An upsert — idempotent. Running it twice sets the same values twice.

code:
CREATE TASK finance_refund_task
  WAREHOUSE = DRIFTWOOD_WH
  SCHEDULE = '5 MINUTE'
  WHEN SYSTEM$STREAM_HAS_DATA('raw.tickets_stream')
AS
  MERGE INTO marts.refund_events ...
  WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ...
  -- no WHEN MATCHED branch at all
caption: Append-only by design — and NOT idempotent. Hold onto that word.

steps.label: ticket_facts_sync_task
steps.sub: Tolerates being run twice with no visible harm
